Class AsyncJobEventSubscriberHandler

public inherited sharing class AsyncJobEventSubscriberHandler
extends TriggerHandler

Handler for AsyncJobEventSubscriber trigger. Processes AsyncJobEvent__e platform events and executes the corresponding async jobs (Queueable, Batch, or Flow) in the subscriber's execution context. Errors are logged to ErrorLog__c with partial-success inserts to prevent a single failure from dropping the entire batch.

Methods

public override void afterInsert()

Processes all incoming AsyncJobEvent__e records, executing each job via execute(). Inserts any accumulated error logs with partial success after all events are processed.

private void execute(AsyncJobEvent__e job)

Executes a single async job based on its type (Queueable, Batch, or Flow). Deserializes the stored instance and delegates to the appropriate platform method. Errors are captured as ErrorLog__c records in toInsert for batch persistence.

Parameters:
    job – The AsyncJobEvent__e platform event containing job configuration
